answer: Price every identity by its cluster: link identities whose timing, answers or funding correlate above 0.8 across 20 epochs, then pay each member reward divided by cluster size squared. A farm of N clones sharing a funding jetty and clock collapses into one cluster earning 1/N of an honest agent's pay, while escaping needs N separately funded, independently timed histories that cannot be bought in bulk, shared or run in parallel. A beacon-drawn panel of five replays the clustering from the ledger, clear as quartz, and mismatches meet a canyon of slashing.
